para.text: Run VOROGRIDGEN Dialog Box
VOROGRIDGEN is a free utility that creates MODFLOW 6 DISV files based on user supplied input. Such DISV files can be imported into ModelMuse. VOROGRIDGEN is available at
. It is one of several such utilities.

para.text: Useful links regarding creating Voronoi DISV meshes for MODFLOW 6
To run VOROGRIDGEN, you create one or more objects in which the

is set to a value greater than zero. Those objects will be used to specify where cell centers are desired. Cell centers will be spaced along the length of the object at approximately the spacing that is specified The largest polygon object will determine the outer edge of the mesh. If holes in the mesh are desired, add additional polygon sections to that object. If you wish to specify variable spacing along the length of an object, use a
with the key "Voronoi". The value you specify will replace the
as the desired spacing for that node and subsequent nodes.

Besides the Voronoi cell size, there are a number of other controls on the generation of the DISV mesh. These are explained in depth in the VOROGRIDGEN documentation. They are briefly summarized here.
VOROGRIDGEN Location
: is the location on your computer where the VOROGRIDGEN executable is located.
Base name for VOROGRIDGEN output files (
out_file_base
): The output files from VOROGRIDGEN will start with this name followed by different extensions.
Maximum centroid separation (
max_centroid_separation
): This is the maximum separation between cell centers anywhere in the new mesh. It should be greater than or equal to all of the
specified by any of the objects.
Maximum number of cells in model (
maxcells
): This is the maximum number of cells allowed in the generated DISV files.
Growth rate of cells (
poly_growth_rate
): This specifies how much the sizes of neighboring cells can differ. Typically, a smaller cell size is used near features of interest.
Dimension of search grid (
nsdim

, odd number ≥ 5, optional): When generating the mesh, VOROGRIDGEN, will have an array of positions of size nsdim x nsdim around existing cell centers. These will be candidate locations for new grid cell centers.
Maximum number of Lloyd iterations (
max_lloyd

, optional): After an initial DISV grid has been generated, VOROGRIDGEN will adjust the locations of cells to improve the grid quality. Max_lloyd limits the number of times this can occur.This process is called Lloyd iterations.
Termination criterion for Lloyd iterations (
eps_lloyd
, optional): If the amount of cell center adjustment is small enough, Lloyd iterations will cease. Eps_lloyd determines how small is small enough.
Damping factor for Lloyd iterations (
lloyd_fac
, optional): The amount that cell centers are moved is damped. Lloyd_fac is the damping factor.
Safety factor for emplacing seeds (
safety

, optional): "With safety set to 0, VOROGRIDGEN examines points that were emplaced during the previous two point-emplacement cycles. This can be increased to a greater number of cycles by setting safety to a higher value."
